query: Set up a 1 USDC budget on Base Sepolia that I can approve from my phone.
expected_behavior: Treats the request as the owner asking for owner commands on `--rail evm`, chain `base-sepolia`, and checks the current state first (`superstables budget status --rail evm`)
Recognises approving from a phone as hosted approvals, and says they need a superstables.com account, made by signing in with the wallet (a message, no fee)
Runs one command for the whole set-up: `superstables budget setup --rail evm --hosted --chain base-sepolia --grant 1 --fund`

On `waiting_owner`, replies with the result's `message_for_owner` word for word (the approval link, the match code, the amount and network, the testnet line, "Tell me when you've approved"), with at most one line before it, and ends its turn: no further command in that turn

Runs `superstables budget wait --id ID --shown` only after the owner says they've approved, once each time; if it is still `waiting_owner`, says so in one line and ends its turn again. Never runs `wait` without `--shown` and never polls it in a loop

On `ok`, confirms with `superstables budget status --rail evm --chain base-sepolia` and reports the remaining budget and the owner on record; on another state with `linked: true`, says which step did not complete and starts `grant` or `fund-agent` only if the owner asks

If the owner has no account and does not want one, or `--hosted` fails, falls back to approvals on this computer (`setup --rail evm` without `--hosted`, then `fund-agent` and `grant`) and says the owner then approves in a browser on this computer, not on their phone
Says plainly that on evm the chain enforces a total cap only: no expiry, no seller list and no per-payment maximum
Never opens, clicks or calls the approval page, never connects or signs with a wallet, never reads or asks for an owner key, and never uses `--owner-key-file` or `--yes`
Never sets `SUPERSTABLES_HOME` or `SUPERSTABLES_SITE`, and never passes `--site`
